release.content: pubfleet 0.1.0 was released on 2026-11-09 from commit d143eef084ff25ffa1d2115352bb8d40b5b63ae1 with these changes.

rows: pubfleet, what a control plane runs across many repositories, split out of pubkit: pubfleet board, board-publish, state, variables and freshness, with the reusable board.yml and nightly.yml, which runs pubkit nightly in each governed checkout and installs the pubkit pubfleet's lock pins (or the release its pubkit input names); it imports pubkit as a library, through the names its README lists

The actions the reusable workflows use move to their latest releases: actions/checkout 7.0.1, actions/setup-python 7.1.0, actions/cache 6.1.0 and actions/upload-artifact 7.0.2, and the integrations scan to integrations' main

release.scope: the published release v0.1.0 of pubfleet
